featuresDesc: We are not just a simple sharing app. We are a gamified ecosystem that restores neighborhood trust.
feature1Desc: Stop throwing usable items in the trash. Give them a second life in others' hands, protecting our nature and lowering CO2 emissions.
feature2Desc: Those who post listings and successfully hand over items are consistently rewarded. Gather Karma points and raise from Supporter to true Eco Hero.
feature3Desc: The platform shows you only items and people nearby. Contact details are unlocked only after a request is approved for safety.
gamificationDesc: ShareFlow deeply values givers. Each successful handover awards (+10 points). Reputation tiers and special badges are granted based on your profile:
tier1Desc: Badge for beginners in generosity. Sprouts making their first contribution to the community.
tier2Desc: Reliable and active neighbor title, consistently providing help to the community.
tier3Desc: Hero of the community! Awarded for sharing many items and supporting sustainable living.
faqDesc: Learn answers to the most common questions about the ShareFlow project.
faqQ1: Is it completely free to use?
faqA1: Yes, ShareFlow is a completely free and non-profit project. All items are shared for free, and selling or renting is strictly prohibited. No hidden fees or commissions.
faqQ2: What are Karma points and how do they benefit me?
faqA2: Karma points show the reliability level of users. High points grant badges, raise community reputation, and make others more likely to trust you with their items.
faqQ3: How is safety and privacy of personal data ensured?
faqA3: Your phone number is only visible to the user whose request you approve. Otherwise, it remains hidden. The app shows your approximate neighborhood, not your exact address, and the distance to the item.
faqQ4: What happens if someone lists damaged, broken, or prohibited items?
faqA4: Members can report unusable or suspicious items. Reports are checked immediately by admins, and violators will have their reputation lowered or be banned.
